## Deliverable

Technical research (data models, storage, protocols, evaluation methods, etc.) goes under `docs/zh-CN/research/`, submitted through a pull request.

Competitor analysis, market and product snapshots, product positioning, pricing and commercial strategy do not belong in this repository. Put those materials in the internal repository. Split mixed reports into distinct technical and commercial documents without maintaining synchronized copies. Conclusions needed by the public design must be independently supported here, not by internal research.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Facts and our own judgement are written separately, with sources
- [ ] What was not verified is stated as such
